caption_L1: This is a bar plot labeled Number of active physicians in Massachusetts in 2020 , by specialty area. There is a categorical scale starting with All other specialities and ending with Total specialty along the x-axis, marked Specialty area. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 20,000 on the y-axis, marked Number of physicians.
caption_L2L3: Massachusetts has the most specialists in the area of psychiatry around 3000 active physicians, of around one thousand more than the other areas of speciality. However all other unnamed specialitys are the largest number of around 7000 active physicians. Radiology is the second biggest speciality with approximately 2000 active physicians, closely followed by the area of surgeons.
